diagnosis: Check C1 is leaking because it passes in every rollout despite the lone decision-maker only having access to S1 and S2, while C1 depends on PF1 (airway concern/attending presence). The model is defaulting to a standard 19:00 start time for backup coverage, which happens to satisfy the check's requirement without needing the specific 20:30 override triggered by PF1.

C1.why: The airway concern and patient-specific attending-presence order change the assignment to the obstetric unit and change the required backup assignment start from the general 19:00 availability start to exactly 20:30.
